notes: Scene 0 is the ten-second teaser before Scene 1; it plays the first moment of Scene 1A from standing height on the wall side, and 1A replays it closer, down in the dust.
Black is the dark wool of a hired man's back pressed over the lens; he lunges in at 1.2 s and the white noon floods the frame.
Everyone stands where Scene 1A plan 1 starts, on the shared foreign_farm grid with the tamarisk trunk at the origin.
The smash cut to the hillside lands on the elder son's arm at the top of its draw, the arm the design note asks for.
The younger son is 19 as the screenplay has him; the design note's twelve is older text.
Sun from 270 and high, the white noon of the heading; the wall's short shadow falls north onto the barley, so the road lies in full sun.
